data.title: 早露 · 温室里的新叶
data.description: 花盆里长出一片浅色的新叶。早露没有碰它，只把写着日期的标签往旁边挪了挪。
data.camera: 中景，植株与玻璃窗同框
data.promptProse: Within the humid, lush expanse of a vast Victorian-style greenhouse, Rosa gently inspects a broad, vibrant green tropical leaf, brushing away a droplet of condensation. Sunlight filters through the overhead glass panels in hazy, diffused shafts, illuminating the exotic foliage, mossy path, and a hanging metal thermometer, creating a serene, immersive botanical environment.
